name: Upstash Workflow Free
free_limit: Upstash Workflow Free: 1,000 billed steps/day, 50 GB bandwidth/month, 10 concurrent steps and 1 MB message size
watch_out: A retry counts as another step; context.call/context.invoke each cost two billed steps and parallel execution incurs extra steps. Free workflow sleep is limited to 7 days, log/DLQ retention to 3 days; persistent daily quota overruns can cause workflow failures via QStash. Not unlimited serverless compute.
